items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Lee Gruber, went down to his place in Philadelphia

ctx.x: So I met the fella that -- he came in to (unintelligible) see me at Marco's Pub last evening -- Lee Gruber, went down to his place in Philadelphia, Joe said all right, I'll book you for two weeks. And, Mundell and I and a bass player went down. And it was -- an awful experience, no drums and no piano, I just felt naked, I didn't know what to do, behind Mundell when he was playing, it's just an odd feeling -- Felt like half of (unintelligible) you were there.
